name: down-dry-verbose
stdout:
stack: pr-1  (dry-run)
→ compose down (all profiles)
  [dry-run] $ docker compose -p 'pr-1' -f 'docker-compose.preview.yml' --profile 'backend' --profile 'frontend' down -v --remove-orphans
→ down: images
  [dry-run] $ IMAGES=$(docker ps -a --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$STACK" \
           --format '{{.Image}}' | sort -u)
for img in $IMAGES; do docker rmi "$img" 2>/dev/null || true; done

→ down: queue-namespace
  [dry-run] $ docker exec shared-temporal-1 temporal operator namespace delete \
  --namespace "$STACK" --yes 2>/dev/null || true

→ down: database
  [dry-run] $ ./hooks/db-branch.sh delete "$STACK"
→ verify (asserting resources are gone)
  [dry-run] $ ./hooks/db-branch.sh ping || exit 1        # can't reach the API ⇒ cannot prove gone
[ "$(./hooks/db-branch.sh count "$STACK")" = "0" ]

  [dry-run] $ docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1                                  # no daemon ⇒ can't tell
docker exec shared-temporal-1 temporal operator namespace list >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1
! docker exec shared-temporal-1 temporal operator namespace describe \
    --namespace "$STACK" >/dev/null 2>&1

  [dry-run] $ docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1                                  # no daemon ⇒ can't tell
! docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -q ":ci\$"

# DNS/network outage would read as "every preview is cleaned up".
curl -sf --max-time 5 "https://preview.example.com/" >/dev/null || exit 1
! curl -sf --max-time 5 "https://backend-pr-1.preview.example.com/health" >/dev/null
